title: Wayfare Rentals Return Deadlines and Late Return Fees by Class
content:
Hub reference card for Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals): the periods that set when a return is required and when it is due, and the late return fee for each vehicle class.

## Late return fee by vehicle class

The late return fee is charged per started day after the grace period that a required return is late, in USD.

| Vehicle class | Late return fee per started day |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | $55.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | $60.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | $65.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | $70.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | $75.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | $90.00 |

## Periods common to every vehicle class

| Item | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Late return grace period | 2 elapsed hours | Hours after the return deadline before a late return fee applies |
| Return after the driver agreement ends | 48 elapsed hours | Hours after the linked driver agreement is deactivated or closed within which the vehicle must be returned |
| Past-due balance threshold | $300.00 | An unpaid balance above this amount for the past-due period requires the vehicle to be returned |
| Past-due period | 7 calendar days | Days an unpaid balance may stay above the threshold before a return is required |
| Notice to due date for balance-driven returns | 72 elapsed hours | Hours from a required return to its return due date |

## Return handling common to every vehicle class

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Return inspection by hub staff before the rental closes | Required |
| Return to the hub drop box after hours | Allowed |
| When an after-hours return counts as returned | At the hub's next opening time |

## Reading the card: hypothetical figures

- A Wayfare Rentals Minivan whose required return is late by two started days after the grace period carries two fees of $75.00 each, $150.00 in all.
- An unpaid balance of exactly $300.00 is not above the threshold; $300.01 is.
